normalization: all capacities and clearances are normalized by the measured native text height H

arc_capacity_side_flip.measured_text_width_source: native exploded text bbox plus native rotation
arc_capacity_side_flip.selection: all runtime candidates satisfying every gate; no handle coordinate segment bbox or object-count literal
arc_capacity_side_flip.post_condition: exact native handle and grip key set; selected grip0 reaches target; selected grips2/3 and every nonselected grip remain within 1e-6
arc_capacity_side_flip.visual_condition: one observed REGEN must complete before the acceptance screenshot

outer_capacity_escalation.scope: runtime discovered ARC mappings whose predicted grip0 is already on the source-circle outer side
outer_capacity_escalation.activation: current_capacity_ratio below required_capacity_ratio after ordinary common-band prediction
outer_capacity_escalation.target_radius_formula: source_radius + ceil(max(minimum_outer_band_h, raw_outer_band_h) / outer_band_quantum_h) * outer_band_quantum_h * H
outer_capacity_escalation.selection: all runtime outer-side candidates requiring a larger quantized radius; no handle coordinate source key segment bbox or object-count literal

evidence_boundary.same_board_regression: user identified both inner-side and already-outer-side short-arc arrow crowding samples; business code references only runtime geometry text metrics H and grip feedback
evidence_boundary.promotion: requires real-host one-object pass plus a different-structure DWG falsification before generic claim
